required_facts.description: The control applies the same machinery to a task whose ground truth is already known.
A passing truth control is required per model before the relation result is reported.
The standardized separation is a True-minus-False mean difference in training-projection standard deviations, averaged over eight partitions.
The scale of the standardized separation is stated, so its magnitude cannot be read as a conventional effect size.
An earlier version failed strict review because the probe was reading the answer token.
The version shown uses neutral symbols whose meaning reverses across examples, and tests transfer to a held-out answer format.
The Gemma point is drawn open because only its point estimate was retained.
The held-out intervals are group bootstrap intervals with 2,000 replicates.
